name: Kaiser Permanente
why: Largest integrated health system (~12.6M members in catalog); kp.org medical bills with guest pay.

name: Quest Diagnostics
why: Largest U.S. lab company; national patient-billing site.

name: Labcorp
why: Second national lab company; Labcorp Patient portal and guest bill pay.

name: AdaptHealth

name: Lincare

name: Apria
why: National home medical equipment / CPAP supplier (~280K); epay.apria.com billing.

name: DaVita Kidney Care
why: Largest U.S. dialysis provider; InstaMed patient payment portal.

name: Mass General Brigham
why: Major academic health system; one combined Patient Gateway (MyChart) bill across its hospitals.

name: Cleveland Clinic
why: Nationally known health system; main-campus record (no system-level record in catalog), MyChart billing.

name: Providence
why: Large multi-state health system (7 states); system-level MyChart billing record.
